text: You always have to believe in yourself, even when people doubt you. If you don't believe in yourself, no one else will.
author: Max Verstappen
context: 2021 F1 World Championship Post-Race Interview, Abu Dhabi

text: Telemetry does not lie. Review your daily inputs with ruthless objectivity.

text: Discipline is your baseline torque. Motivation is just wheelspin.

text: Hit the apex every single day. Precision compounds over 100 laps.

text: A bad stint does not ruin the race. Box for fresh tires, reset, and push again.

text: Manage your energy like tire degradation: conserve in traffic, push in clean air.

text: Your code is your race setup. Tune it patiently before you go for top speed.

text: Clear mental telemetry beats frantic effort every time.
